fix(codeon): stabilize LandingPreflight digest and verification output (#61)

* fix(codeon): use GitHub thread updatedAt for LandingPreflight digest stability

build_threads previously stamped each review thread's updated_at with the
current observation time, so the decision digest changed on every poll and a
Passed LandingPreflight could never accumulate two stable observations. Fetch
the thread's real updatedAt from GitHub and use that instead.

* fix(codeon): include pageInfo in review thread comments query

The GraphQL connection deserializer requires pageInfo; the previous
query omitted it, so LandingPreflight observations failed to parse
and the operation entered provider recovery.

* fix(codeon): raise verification output cap and cancel issue-level recoveries

- Raise planning evidence runtime output limit from 64 KiB to 4 MiB so
  full verification command output is not truncated (Revision outcomes
  no longer fail verification).
- When an issue transitions back to Todo/Cancelled, cancel the active
  issue-gated recovery attempt, seal its runtime closure receipt, and
  release the attempt so the picker can start a fresh run.
- Add a recovery-operation lock helper used by the cancel path.
